title: buildme-rides-the-chart
intention: The ENTRY GATE — a build_inspector filter, buildme_rides_the_chart, firing at the emit chokepoint: a BUILDME crossing for a cast ticket REFUSES unless a berthed chart chain in instance-space claims that ticket (the berth's ticket field — the handshake the orient door already checks against the tickets on file). Skipping /chart becomes a build error by the same physics that refuses stage-skipping inside the chain: the skill-door discipline moves from prose (sail step 0) into the chokepoint, where it fires whether or not anyone remembers it.
why: The discipline that makes builds chart first lives in skill prose — policy, not physics (Law 4 debt). Akien named the stake in numbers: Fable is 64% of usage; every discipline the chokepoint enforces is discipline the model no longer spends context remembering — the sooner the gate is trusted, the sooner that rate drops. This is the trust-transfer stone: the chain now EMITS a complete preamble; this gate makes riding it the only way through the door.
traces_to: Law 4 — a rule that matters is enforced by physics, not policy; sail step 0's refusal was the IOU, this retires it
Law 1 — the preamble is compiled once per request into berths; a build from conversation instead of berths re-derives the settled
Law 8 — a build that skipped the preamble is the hollow build; the gate is entry-by-proof at the door where builds begin
Law 7 — the refusal is loud at the chokepoint, and the journaled record of a refused crossing is permanent

falsifier.proves_green: proof gate: teeth in cairn/machines/build_inspector/proofs/test_inspector.py (a chartless cast-ticket BUILDME reds; a charted one greens; non-BUILDME crossings and un-cast components untouched; the red names the missing chain, not a vibe) under the tester's netns seal. Live gate: this stone's own BUILDME crossing rides its own gate green — the berths claiming this ticket are on disk before the code exists — and a synthetic chartless BUILDME reds for real.
falsifier.proves_red: RED on any of: a cast ticket's BUILDME crossing passing the chokepoint with no berthed chart claiming it; the filter firing on non-BUILDME crossings or on components with no cast ticket; the gate mutating or retro-judging an already-journaled record; the emitted refusal failing to name the ticket and the missing chain; the door passing what the promotion gate refuses.
falsifier.horizon: re-read when the exit gate lands (chart-validate edge (a) + chart-hypothesize edge (b) — the loop-closing pair this stone is the entry half of); when chain-depth-for-claim wants tightening beyond v0's bound; when skill@v1 registration (sail edge (d)) gives the gate a skill vocabulary instead of berth-file inference.
